description: This file defines classes related to handling connection preambles in Orleans networking, including serialization, deserialization, and reading/writing connection preamble data over network streams.

classes.name: ConnectionPreamble
classes.description: Represents the connection preamble data including protocol version, node identity, silo address, and cluster ID, with serialization attributes.

classes.name: ConnectionPreambleHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to serialize, deserialize, and read/write connection preambles over network connections.

methods.name: ConnectionPreambleHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serializer for ConnectionPreamble.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a ConnectionPreamble object and writes it to the connection output stream, including length prefix.

methods.name: WriteLength
methods.description: Writes the length prefix for the preamble using little-endian encoding.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a ConnectionPreamble from the connection input stream, handling length prefix and buffer management.
